description: TinyLink v3.5: 5-Phase Feature Suite & Complete Mobile Responsive UI Polish

userStories.title: Mobile Responsive UI Polish & Layout Overhaul
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the TinyLink console, modals, drawer, and tables to be completely responsive and touch-optimized without horizontal overflow or cramped touch targets.
acceptanceCriteria: All views (Dashboard, Studio, Bio Studio, Modals, Tables, Drawer, KPIs) adapt cleanly down to 320px width
Interactive buttons and tabs have min-height 44px touch targets with touch-action: manipulation
Zero horizontal scrolling or viewport overflow across all pages
Chrome DevTools MCP visual inspection verifies 375x812 and 320x568 viewports
Typecheck and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Completed: Added overflow-x: hidden to html and body, minmax(280px, 1fr) for bio-grid, responsive breakpoints for 540px, 480px, 420px, and 360px, touch targets min 44px for workspace tabs, mobile-actions, and dialogs. Verified with 20 unit tests.

userStories.title: Branded QR Code Design Studio
userStories.description: As a creator, I want to customize and brand my short link QR codes with center logos, corner styles, custom colors, and high-resolution exports.
acceptanceCriteria: QR Studio modal accessible from link items and Inspector
Supports center logos with presets (Globe, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, GitHub, LinkedIn) and custom image URL
Supports corner shapes (square, rounded, extra-rounded), foreground colors/gradients, and background colors
Supports error correction levels (L, M, Q, H)
Exports high-resolution SVG and PNG at 512px, 1024px, 2048px
Typecheck and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented generateBrandedQrSvg engine with center logos (Globe, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, GitHub, LinkedIn, custom), corner shapes (square, rounded, dots), dual gradients, and error correction levels (L,M,Q,H). Added POST /api/qr and GET /api/qr/:slug endpoints with vector SVG and 512/1024/2048px PNG export. Built QR Studio modal in console.

userStories.title: Deep Linking & Smart Mobile App Launchers
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want short links to automatically open native mobile apps (Instagram, YouTube, Spotify, Twitter, TikTok, Telegram) on iOS/Android with web fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema supports deepLink flag on short links
Detects app target from URL and generates native mobile URI scheme
Edge redirect engine serves responsive universal launch bridge for mobile user agents with seamless web fallback
Toggle in Shorten Studio and Inspector to enable smart deep linking
Typecheck and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented detectAppDeepLink for YouTube (vnd.youtube:), Spotify (spotify:), X/Twitter (twitter:), Instagram (instagram:), TikTok (snssdk1233:), and Telegram (tg:). Built responsive edge universal launch bridge with meta refresh fallback and universal app scheme launch button. Added deepLink checkbox in Shorten Studio and Inspector modal. Verified with comprehensive unit tests.

userStories.title: One-Click Multi-Channel Campaign Generator
userStories.description: As a growth lead, I want to generate tagged short links for Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok in 1 click from a single destination URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Campaign Generator modal generates channel variants with automatic UTM parameters in 1 click
POST /api/campaigns endpoint creates batch links with shared campaign tag in KV
Dashboard allows filtering by campaign tag and displays aggregate campaign metrics
Typecheck and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Completed: Added POST /api/campaigns batch creation endpoint with auto UTM tagging (utm_source=<channel>, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=<campaign>). Built Multi-Channel Campaign Generator modal in console. Added campaign filter dropdown, aggregate campaign metrics summary banner, and campaign tag filtering in links view. Verified with unit tests.

userStories.title: Smart Expired-Link Actions & Real-Time Countdown Timers
userStories.description: As an event organizer, I want expired links to auto-redirect to waitlists and scheduled links to display a live real-time countdown timer.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema supports expiredAction ('message' | 'redirect') and expiredUrl
Expired links with redirect action seamlessly 302-redirect to expiredUrl instead of 410
Scheduled links with startsAt render a real-time ticking countdown timer that auto-activates when reaching zero
Typecheck and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Completed: Added expiredAction ('message' | 'redirect') and expiredUrl to URLData schema. Implemented seamless 302 redirect to expiredUrl on expiration when expiredAction is 'redirect'. Built real-time ticking countdown timer with /assets/status.js ticker that auto-activates when reaching zero. Added controls in Shorten Studio and Inspector modal. Verified with unit tests.

userStories.title: Bio Page Lead Capture & Newsletter Subscription Block
userStories.description: As a creator, I want an email subscription block on my bio page so visitors can subscribe to my newsletter, and I can export leads.
acceptanceCriteria: BioPageData schema supports leadCapture configuration
Public /bio/:handle renders responsive email capture form matching active theme
POST /bio/:handle/subscribe endpoint validates emails, enforces rate limits, and persists leads in KV
Dashboard Bio Studio displays subscriber count badge, leads modal, and one-click CSV export
Typecheck and tests pass with 0 errors
userStories.notes: Completed: Added leadCapture config to BioPageData. Rendered responsive newsletter block on public /bio/:handle with /assets/bio.js AJAX subscription handler. Added POST /bio/:handle/subscribe endpoint with rate limiting, deduplication, and persistence under b:leads:<handle>. Added GET /api/bio/:handle/subscribers with RFC4180 CSV export. Added Leads modal, subscriber count badge, and Lead Capture configuration in Bio Editor with live mobile preview. Verified with unit tests.
